title: On Data Thinning for Model Validation in Small Area Estimation
summary: Small area estimation produces estimates of population parameters for geographic and demographic subgroups with limited sample sizes. Such estimates are critical for policy decisions, yet principled validation of these models remains a challenge. Unlike conventional predictive settings, validation data are rarely available. Data thinning splits a single observation into independent training and test components.
